purpose: Test the local metric-only mixed time-space derivative escape route left open by C10.65s6fO. Work off shell in the hard quadratic functional: do not impose the hard-mode dispersion relation to identify otherwise independent omega^r k^s structures. Derive the constant-homogeneous spatial-conformal weight of local projectable ADM quadratic monomials built from K_i^j, R_i^j and spatial covariant derivatives, and determine whether an exact-preserving retuning of the complete hard quadratic functional can change the homogeneous hard-hard-soft cubic response.

frozen_domain.forbidden_shortcut: never use omega=omega(k) to cancel independent quadratic monomials

interpretation_if_pass: Within local metric-only projectable ADM operators built from K_i^j, R_i^j and D_i, exact preservation of the complete off-shell hard quadratic functional prevents mixed time-space derivative retuning from changing the constant-homogeneous hard-hard-soft cubic response. Cancellation that appears only after inserting omega(k) is not an exact action-level preservation and is rejected.
escape_routes_not_excluded: additional fields or compensators with independent homogeneous transformation laws
explicit spurions that alter homogeneous conformal weight
a genuinely new symmetry relating sectors while requiring a separately re-certified quadratic action
abandoning exact preservation and re-deriving/re-certifying the quadratic phenomenology
nonclaims: not a no-go for RTK as a whole
not a theorem for extra-field or compensator completions
not a theorem for nonlocal actions
does not unblock k=0.03 Mpc^-1 production
